question: Does the frozen V56 SPCX cash-open route produce a fully attributable and technically correct prospective decision and, if eligible, a protected and completely resolved live lifecycle under its exact configured contract?
outcomes_to_capture: receipt-causal completed opening-bar source identity and trade count
decision side, reference price, prior-close target, blockers, and readiness
freshness at poll and immediately before submission
entry acknowledgement, fill, fees, slippage, and leverage
reduce-only stop and target order identities and prices
position, liquidation distance, funding, and venue reconciliation
exit reason, fill, fees, slippage, funding, gross and net PnL
MFE, MAE, peak giveback, and no-action 5m/15m/30m/60m path
any rejected order, source gap, venue anomaly, or unattributed state transition

interpretation_rules.no_signal: Record the exact blockers and treat one quiet cash open as cadence evidence only.
interpretation_rules.eligible_but_withheld: Classify the technical or routing cause and measure the no-action path without calling it a fill or PnL.
interpretation_rules.open_lifecycle: Treat marks as provisional until the lifecycle is resolved and venue orders reconcile.
interpretation_rules.resolved_win_or_loss: Report the exact result but do not infer profitability or failure from one lifecycle.
interpretation_rules.technical_mismatch: Escalate immediately; do not reinterpret the affected lifecycle as economic evidence. Any live repair requires explicit human approval.

minimum_evidence_to_update_diagnosis: One fully attributable eligible decision and resolved lifecycle per configured side. One side or one lifecycle is diagnostic only.
minimum_evidence_for_change_recommendati: A predeclared compatible prospective window with both-side coverage, exact costs and latency, resolved protection and exits, missed-opportunity comparison, chronological stability, and largest-winner sensitivity.
success_metrics: Every eligible decision has exactly one action or explicit withholding reason.
Any entry uses the frozen side, target anchor, 80-bps stop, sizing, and maximum hold.
Any open position is protected by reconciled reduce-only venue orders.
The completed lifecycle reconciles fills, fees, funding, and net PnL without source or identity gaps.
failure_or_escalation_triggers: profile, run, route, side, or decision-time identity mismatch
missing or unfavorable prior-close target binding
missing, duplicate, non-reduce-only, or unreconciled protection
position, order, fill, fee, funding, or ledger/venue mismatch
source recovery or data gap crossing an active lifecycle without explicit attribution
falsifier: Any frozen identity mismatch, unresolved technical path, or materially different runtime entry/exit contract invalidates the lifecycle as evidence for this hypothesis.
